issue.title: chezmoi just test-nvim and test-hammerspoon cannot load busted.runner in non-interactive shells on athena

task_type_fields.impact:
`just test` (which runs test-nvim and test-hammerspoon first) is red for every agent working
in the chezmoi repo on athena, so agents cannot use it as a gate and fall back to partial
recipes. GitHub Actions CI is unaffected.
task_type_fields.location: chezmoi repo Justfile test-nvim / test-hammerspoon recipes; athena ~/.luarocks busted 2.3.0-1 via ~/.luarocks/bin/nlua
task_type_fields.repro:
On athena, in a non-interactive shell (as SASE agents run), in a chezmoi checkout:

    just test-nvim          # also: just test-hammerspoon

Both recipes die before any spec runs:

    module 'busted.runner' not found
    .../.luarocks/lib/luarocks/rocks-5.1/busted/2.3.0-1/bin/busted:3: in function 'fn'
    /home/bryan/.luarocks/bin/nlua:89: in main chunk
    error: recipe `test-nvim` failed on line 122 with exit code 1

Root cause (from bob-cli-ib.2): busted 2.3.0-1 lives in the user luarocks tree
(`~/.luarocks`), which is only on `LUA_PATH`/`LUA_CPATH` after
`eval "$(luarocks path --bin)"` in an interactive shell profile. With that loaded, every test
recipe passes. Reproduced identically on the clean base f1da6b64 (bob-cli-ib.1), during
bob-cli-ib.2 and bob-cli-ib.5, and again by the bob-cli-ib land agent at 6af21b40. Fix
candidates: have the `test-nvim` and `test-hammerspoon` recipes (or `_setup`) run
`eval "$(luarocks path --bin)"` when `luarocks` exists, or document the CI-parity setup.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed independently by bob-cli-ib.1, bob-cli-ib.2, and bob-cli-ib.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes), and reproduced by the bob-cli-ib land agent. It is a local toolchain issue unrelated to the crontab epic.
